extensionDescription.message: Team chat side panel: talk with your team's AI agent, and send it links from the sites you choose.

storeDesc.message:
TeamClu opens a chat side panel next to any web page, where you talk with your teammates and your team's AI agent.

What it does:
• Side panel chat — chat with your team's AI agent and teammates without leaving the current tab.
• Link button (optional) — add a site in Settings and approve Chrome's prompt for that site. Then hover a link there and click the small TeamClu button: the side panel opens a new chat for that link with the link (and the page it is on) in the chat box. Nothing is sent to the agent until you press Send.
• Team sessions — shared conversations with live sync.

Requirements:
• A TeamClu account (email + password, email code, or Google sign-in).
• Agents are provided by your team (a computer or server running the TeamClu agent connected to your team).

Privacy: no site access is granted at install — only sites you add for the link button. No background page reading and no browsing-history collection. Error reports are off unless you turn them on. Full policy: https://www.teamclu.ai/privacy-extension
